tldr: Saturn in Virgo: discipline must be learned through craft, health, and daily refinement.
body: With Saturn in Virgo, the work is developing skill, discernment, and useful routines without turning improvement into punishment.
gift: Mastery of craft, practical intelligence, and devotion to meaningful service.

note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
